sheet.quickResultLayout: unchanged: one horizontal row with dividers
sheet.multipleResults: retain the accepted per-expression horizontal answer row and its selection/copy semantics

library.underlyingSheetGeometry: preserved while the library is open

lightAppearance.scope: shared light-sheet typography, colors, spacing and secondary-text dimming shown in round 33

verificationBoundary: Visual selection does not certify native focus, screen-reader behavior, actual clipboard or computation. Constrained long expressions/results and zero-room completion retain their pending verification requirements.

darkAppearance.direction: neutral graphite-black surfaces without a blue cast; based on VS Code Dark+
darkAppearance.adaptation: Neutral surfaces and number/operator colors draw on the official themes; calculator roles are adapted. This is not an exact reproduction of all VS Code UI tokens.

paletteCalibration.historySurface: separate from the permanently bounded input/result panel
paletteCalibration.baselineMeaning: same physical layout as the previous revision at 70%; compact layout becomes the reference

quickHistory.height: actual remaining visible rows plus padding; capped by available work area, then scroll
quickHistory.emptyRemainder: no empty extension or reserved height
quickHistory.consumeBehavior: Up removes each recalled entry from the remaining rows above input; top of history descends, Down restores it
quickHistory.mainPanelScreenBounds: fixed while history changes; input/result border does not stretch or move
quickHistory.geometryStatus: Revised appearance accepted by the user in round 39; Windows geometry and persistence recorded; full cross-platform native validation remains outstanding.

rowSeparator.placement: between adjacent history entries only, at the text content edges
